_comment: Trading-hours configuration for market-status detection. Edited by ops without code changes. Times are LOCAL to the market's zone (the zoneinfo zone name in 'timezone'). 'trading_days' are 0=Monday .. 6=Sunday (matches Python's datetime.weekday()). 'session_blocks' is a list of {open, close} in HH:MM local time, in case a market ever has multiple sessions per day; is_market_open/market_status handle the list shape transparently.
